summary: Re-adjudication at digest sha256:c02e15c6 after the single-line revision to lumen-claim-dynamic-cross-pod-routing (capability dynamic-shard-topology, WI #1988). The gate command gained --features operator: cargo test -p lumen --features operator --test routed_shard_e2e forward_write_and_forward_read_land_on_owning_shard -- --exact --nocapture. routed_shard_e2e.rs is #![cfg(feature = "operator")], so previously the binary compiled empty and --exact matched zero tests (false-green). With --features operator the named test now compiles and executes (verified 1 passed, 12 filtered out), and its oracle is the real two-Engine + RoutedRouter h2c cross-pod forwarding e2e, independent of aw ec. False-green axis is the material change and is now satisfied; oracle_independent, loopholes_checked, assertions_specific (unchanged text: reads/writes follow the delivered ownership map to the owning shard), capability_claim_coverage, and required_dimensions all hold. Everything else is unchanged from the previously-accepted digest sha256:27eb580d. All six axes pass; findings empty. Verdict: accepted. Agent-backed evidence under ec_review_backing (#1829); reviewer_kind stays agent and a post-completion human batch audit may still reopen it.
